en: Black‑and‑white illustrated bird's‑eye view of a large 19th‑century industrial complex with multiple multi‑story brick factory buildings, several tall smoking chimneys, internal courtyards, rail or cart tracks, and small workers' houses and gardens around the perimeter. A river or canal borders the lower edge with a small dock. In the distant background on a hill stands a large Gothic‑style cathedral or castle dominating the landscape. The image looks like a lithographic promotional postcard for an industrial plant. Some faint handwritten marks are visible along the left edge, but no clear printed caption or title.
